points.description: States that abstraction (or an equivalent idea such as hiding implementation details or focusing on essential features) is an advantage of object-oriented programming.
States that reusability (or an equivalent idea such as code reuse or reusable code) is an advantage of object-oriented programming.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both advantages named in the model answer: abstraction and reusability. Award the relevant point for equivalent wording; award no marks for an advantage that does not match either idea. If only one advantage is given, only that point is earned.
